description: Return the Studio billing link so the customer can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel their monthly plan in Studio. Plan purchases and changes are never executed through MCP.

plan_id.description: Target plan if upgrading or downgrading.

workspace.description: Act in this workspace, e.g. one of your client workspaces (id from list_workspaces). Default: the workspace this connection uses.
